note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alates not recorded; worker monomorphic. Synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow to reddish brown; antennae uniformly coloured, paler than head; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at base; body and legs pale yellow to pale brown. Head sparsely setose, body more densely setose. Body length 4.50–5.20 mm. Head rectangular-oval, sides slightly convex and narrowed anteriorly (length to base of mandibles 1.05–1.30, maximum width 0.91–1.10, width at mandibular base 0.65–0.76 mm; maximum width/length index 0.870–0.894, mandibular base width/maximum width index 0.591–0.663). Antennae 15–16-segmented; with 15 segments segment 3 is shortest, with 16 segments segment 4 is shortest. Labrum ligulate, sides weakly convergent to a rounded apex, lateral margin with a row of longer setae, a few minute setae also on the body. Mandibles falcate, weakly incurved apically (length 0.61–0.73 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.56–0.63). Left mandible with a well-developed tooth at about the apical third (tooth-to-apex distance 0.18–0.23 mm, tooth-to-apex/mandible length index 0.280–0.309). Right mandible with a small vestigial tooth slightly below the corresponding tooth of the left mandible. Postmentum slightly longer than wide, sides convex, constricted in the anterior third (length 0.63–0.78, maximum width 0.48–0.50 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin slightly concave; length 0.39–0.47, width 0.65–0.82 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head pale yellow to pale brown; antennae much paler than head, basal segments paler still; postclypeus slightly paler than head; body and legs yellow-white. Head and body rather densely setose. Head subcircular (length to base of mandibles 1.05–1.10, maximum width 1.20–1.28 mm). Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shortest or nearly equal to segment 5, segment 4 slightly longer. Postclypeus inflated, setose, less than half as long as wide (length 0.25, width 0.60–0.65 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.36–0.38, width 0.63–0.68 mm); anterior and posterior margins slightly concave.
